description: When the shell's route effect applies a URI (🎫️ 26/09/23 C10). `fire` = the route effect runs for `uri` and `apply` is whether it must apply it; `begin` starts an application and names it; `settle` ends the named application with whether it took effect (`false` = the shell was not ready: no session, plugin or app yet); `invalidate` = a replaced session (boot, worker loss, hot swap, a changed human) or an explicit navigation. A hub document opened from a space keeps the space's URI, so an applied URI that is applied again closes that document — measured live as a note closing ~1.4 s after it mounted.

scenarios.name: a document opened from a space survives every later route effect
a route the shell was not ready for is applied once it is
a new URI is always applied
an explicit navigation to the URI already shown applies it again
a replaced session re-applies the route behind it
a session replaced while a route was applying leaves that route unapplied
